You can acknowledge a real mistake without treating an entire outcome as your fault. A repair may be possible, but contacting another person or forgiving someone is optional. If the situation involves coercion, abuse, or danger, prioritize safety and support.

:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="An original example"}
After giving an incorrect time, Lee identifies the mistake they made, the unclear message they received, and the actual impact. They send a correction to the people affected. They do not need to promise that no similar mistake will ever happen again.
:::
